summary: Korn Ferry filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing that its Board declared a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.55 per share on September 8, 2026. The dividend is payable October 15, 2026 to holders of record at the close of business on September 22, 2026. No advisor, premium, stake, or transaction is involved. This is an ordinary capital-return action rather than a special-situation event. The press release reiterated the Board's discretion to amend, revoke, or suspend the quarterly dividend policy based on earnings, capital requirements, financial condition, and debt terms. No risk-arb angle applies.
